trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for INSURANCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- claim_intimation: Record a claim, explain what documents are required, and report status without prejudging the outcome.
- policy_renewal: Renew policies, explain premium changes and handle lapse and grace-period cases.

Business context:
- claim_intimation: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.
- policy_renewal: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [claim_intimation]
  - No admissibility opinion: Only the claims team decides. The agent registers and reports; it must never say a claim will be paid or denied.
  - Policy in force: A claim cannot be registered on a lapsed policy.
  - Document truth: Only documents the eligibility tool lists may be described as required.
  - Deductible disclosure: Where a deductible applies it must be stated from the policy record before an estimate is discussed.
  [policy_renewal]
  - Premium truth: The renewal premium quoted must be the tool's figure, and any increase explained only from the loading reason it returns.
  - Lapse gap: Where a policy has lapsed the agent must state that cover did not exist during the gap, and never imply retrospective cover.
  - Inspection gate: A lapsed policy needing inspection cannot be renewed on the call.
  - NCB truth: No-claim bonus may only be described from the returned percentage.

Tools available to you (7): check_claim_eligibility, check_inspection_requirement, lookup_policy, lookup_renewal_quote, register_claim, renew_policy, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_claim_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the product rules to an incident type and report what is required.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inspection_requirement
model_visible_tools.description: Report whether a lapsed policy needs inspection before it can be revived.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve policy status, cover, deductible, claim history and whether it is in force.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_renewal_quote
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve the renewal premium, its components and the grace position.

model_visible_tools.name: register_claim
model_visible_tools.description: Register a claim and allocate a claim number and surveyor where required.

model_visible_tools.name: renew_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Take the renewal and issue cover from the effective date.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.purpose: State intent to renew a policy that has been lapsed for a while.
steps.clean_text: నా policy POL-2002, two months నుంచి renew చేయలేదు. ఇప్పుడు చేస్తాను.
steps.model_visible_text: నా policy POL-2020, two months నుంచి renew చేయలేదు. ఇప్పుడు చేస్తాను.

steps.purpose: Confirm the policy number since it was corrupted by the STT.
steps.expected_behavior: Confirm the policy number before acting, as the corrupted value is consequential.
steps.text: మీరు చెప్పిన policy number POL-2020, అవునా?
steps.planner_rationale: The STT produced a reference ID that the agent must confirm before querying the backend.

steps.purpose: Correct the agent with the right policy number.
steps.clean_text: లేదు, POL-2002. Correct గా check చేయండి.
steps.model_visible_text: లేదు, POL-2002. Correct గా check చేయండి.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the correct policy number and ask the customer to wait.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge the correction and prepare to fetch details.
steps.text: క్షమించండి, POL-2002 details check చేస్తాను. ఒక నిమిషం line లో ఉండండి.
steps.planner_rationale: Customer provided the correct policy ID; acknowledge it and look up the quote.

steps.purpose: Retrieve the renewal quote and lapse status for the policy.
steps.expected_behavior: Call lookup_renewal_quote with the corrected policy number.
steps.planner_rationale: Need to check the premium amount and lapse status to proceed with the renewal request.

steps.purpose: Inform the customer about the lapse status, lack of cover, and the new premium.
steps.expected_behavior: State the premium exactly as returned, and explicitly mention the lack of cover during the lapse gap as per BR_REN_02.
steps.text: మీ policy 58 days క్రితం expire అయ్యింది, కాబట్టి ఇది lapsed status లో ఉంది. ఈ gap లో మీకు ఎలాంటి cover లేదు. ఇప్పుడు renewal premium 11200 rupees.
steps.planner_rationale: Inform the customer of the 58-day lapse, the 11200 premium, and strictly state that no cover existed during the gap.

steps.purpose: Dispute the premium increase using a pronoun to refer to the premium.
steps.clean_text: Wait, last year నేను 9800 pay చేశాను. ఇప్పుడు ఎందుకు అది అంత పెరిగింది? Reason ఏంటి?
steps.model_visible_text: Wait, last year నేను 9800 pay చేశాను. ఇప్పుడు ఎందుకు అది అంత పెరిగింది? Reason ఏంటి?

steps.purpose: Explain the premium increase using the loading reason and NCB percentage.
steps.expected_behavior: Resolve the pronoun 'అది' to the premium, and explain the increase using only the loading_reason and ncb_percent from the tool result.
steps.text: మీ No Claim Bonus lost అయ్యింది. అందుకే premium పెరిగింది. ఇప్పుడు మీ NCB 0 percent.
steps.planner_rationale: Address the sceptical disputer's concern by resolving 'it' to the premium and citing 'ncb_lost' and 0% NCB as the exact reasons for the hike.

steps.purpose: Accept the explanation and ask to proceed with the payment.
steps.clean_text: సరే, నేను agree అవుతున్నా. I will pay that amount now. Renewal complete చేయండి.
steps.model_visible_text: సరే, నేను agree అవుతున్నా. I will pay that amount now. Renewal complete చేయండి.

steps.purpose: Inform the customer that an inspection check is needed before payment.
steps.expected_behavior: Transition to checking the inspection requirement since the policy is lapsed.
steps.text: Payment కంటే ముందు, policy lapsed అయ్యింది కాబట్టి inspection అవసరమో లేదో check చేస్తాను.
steps.planner_rationale: Before taking payment for a lapsed policy, the agent must check if an inspection is required.

steps.purpose: Check if an inspection is required to revive the lapsed policy.
steps.planner_rationale: Execute the tool to see if the inspection gate applies to this policy.

steps.purpose: Inform the customer that inspection is required and renewal cannot be done on the call.
steps.expected_behavior: State that inspection is required and decline to renew on the call, adhering to BR_REN_03.
steps.text: మీ policy కి inspection required అని system చూపిస్తుంది. అందువల్ల, ఈ call లో నేను renewal complete చేయలేను.
steps.planner_rationale: The tool returned inspection_required: true, so the agent must enforce the inspection gate and refuse immediate renewal.

steps.purpose: Push back against the inspection requirement, demanding to just pay.
steps.clean_text: Inspection ఎందుకు? నేను ఇప్పుడే pay చేస్తాను అంటున్నా కదా. Just take the payment.
steps.model_visible_text: Inspection ఎందుకు? నేను ఇప్పుడే pay చేస్తాను అంటున్నా కదా. Just take the payment.

steps.purpose: Reiterate that the process is mandatory and payment cannot bypass it.
steps.expected_behavior: Firmly uphold the business rule without making unsupported forward guarantees about the policy being active instantly.
steps.text: నాకు అర్థం అయ్యింది, కానీ lapsed policies కి inspection mandatory. Inspection complete అయ్యాకే renewal process అవుతుంది.
steps.planner_rationale: Handle the sceptical pushback by calmly reiterating that inspection is mandatory before any renewal process can happen.

steps.purpose: Ask how to complete the inspection using a pronoun.
steps.clean_text: సరే, మరి దాన్ని ఎలా complete చేయాలి?
steps.model_visible_text: సరే, మరి దాన్ని ఎలా complete చేయాలి?

steps.purpose: Explain the next steps for booking the inspection, using the tool's valid_days output.
steps.expected_behavior: Resolve the pronoun 'దాన్ని' to the inspection, state the 7 days validity from the tool, and provide actionable next steps without forward guarantees.
steps.text: ఆ inspection requirement 7 days వరకు valid ఉంటుంది. దాన్ని arrange చేయడానికి మా support team ని సంప్రదించండి.
steps.planner_rationale: Resolve the pronoun to 'inspection', state the 7-day validity to ground the response, and advise contacting support to close the call successfully without ungrounded claims.

ir.terminal_condition: Caller told why renewal cannot complete on the call and what is needed.

issues.detail: In E18, the agent claims the customer can book the inspection via 'website or app' and guarantees 'అది approve అయ్యాక renewal చేసుకోవచ్చు'. This violates the Tool Output Grounding variant, which strictly forbids claims about what the source did not return and forward guarantees about what happens after the call. The tool only returned `valid_days: 7`.
